test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Walking at a speed of 5.4 km/h, Rohit takes 40 minutes to reach his school from his home. What time will he take if he walks 8 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Rohit = 5.4 km/h

Time taken = 40 minutes

New speed = 8 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

First, calculate the distance between Rohit's home and school:

Time taken = 40 minutes = 40 / 60 hours = 2/3 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 5.4 × (2/3)

⇒ Distance = 3.6 km

Now, calculate the time taken at the new speed:

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 3.6 / 8

⇒ Time = 0.45 hours

⇒ Time = 0.45 × 60 minutes

⇒ Time = 27 minutes

**∴ Rohit will take 27 minutes to reach his school if he walks at 8 km/h.**
